elements.label: About
elements.value: Physics-based upward impulse with coyote time and input buffering for reliable jump feel.

onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/abilities/properties/jump.schema.json, set jp_c_style to {{jp_c_style}}]
Set jump style to {{jp_c_style}} for the Jump ability.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/abilities/properties/jump.schema.json, set jp_c_coyote to {{jp_c_coyote}}]
Set coyote time to {{jp_c_coyote}} for the Jump ability. Short=80ms, Long=200ms.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/abilities/properties/jump.schema.json, set jp_t_impulse to {{jp_t_impulse}}]
Set JumpAbility.jumpImpulse to {{jp_t_impulse}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/abilities/properties/jump.schema.json, set jp_t_buffer to {{jp_t_buffer}}]
Set JumpAbility.jumpBufferTime to {{jp_t_buffer}} milliseconds.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/abilities/properties/jump.schema.json, set jp_t_coyote to {{jp_t_coyote}}]
Set JumpAbility.coyoteTime to {{jp_t_coyote}} milliseconds.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/abilities/properties/jump.schema.json, set jp_t_cooldown to {{jp_t_cooldown}}]
Set JumpAbility.jumpCooldown to {{jp_t_cooldown}} milliseconds.
